name: PBGIA reference-invariant generator learning (fresh rerun)
primary_question: reference-independent proportionality of generated-field integral I to continuous P(2D)/A(3D)

primary_losses.geometry: prototype-balanced variance of log mean(I/G_true), no chosen ruler
primary_losses.rotation_shift: within-prototype CV^2 over rotations and shifts
primary_losses.orientation: axis-angle squared for identifiable major-axis only
primary_losses.noise: paired log q/noise vs clean; pre-specified ablations

generator_2d.parity: odd derivative axis, even transverse axis

generator_3d.parity: one odd axis + two even transverse axes, symmetric transverse interchange

optimizer.bounds_and_maxiter: must freeze before running; run to specified convergence or explicit budget limit

stages: 2D validation selection and frozen new test
3D symmetry family and genuine train/validation/test if resources permit

data_policy.split_by: continuous prototype ID, NOT image rotations

references: multiple training-only circles of different radius

phase1_definition_of_done: precommitted 2D experiment with independent frozen test and calibration-free proportionality metrics, raw data, uncertainty, and comparisons
phase2_definition_of_done: 3D prototype-level independently split surface-area experiment with honest limitations and same primary metrics
